title: "More Saucer Witnesses" - Columbia Basin News, Pasco, Washington (July 1952)
description: Small newspaper clipping headlined "More Saucer Witnesses" mounted on a file page, from the Columbia Basin News, Pasco, Washington. It reports further flying saucer sightings over the Kennewick-Pasco area, including a circular or disc-like object with lights around its perimeter seen from a Richland drive-in theater, a cluster of saucers reported by youths in the Navy Homes area, and "tandem-saucers." An FBI Seattle stamp dated JUL 31 1952 and file number 100-18945-36 appear at bottom.
